title: Source
description: Where observations come from: a news outlet, a social account, a field worker. One line of sources.jsonl. Holds no personal data.

name.description: Outlet or organisation name (e.g. a newspaper). For individual social accounts and field workers use a neutral label such as 'Social account' or 'Field worker'.

platform.description: For social and video sources: the platform (e.g. facebook, youtube, x).

account_ref.description: Salted SHA-256 of the account handle, so the same account can be recognised across posts without storing who it is. Never the handle itself.

domain.description: Website domain for news and public-record sources.

is_simulated.description: True for simulated field workers and injected contamination sources.
